subject: general
question: What kind of a resource is water?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Cyclic**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Recyclable resources are resources that can be formed any number of times. Similarly, **water** is a cyclical resource.
 
• Water in oceans, rivers, and seas evaporates and condenses to form clouds.
 
• When it rains, water falls from these clouds onto the ground and flows into water sources.
 
• **Coal, minerals, fossil fuels,** etc. It is also an example of a recyclable resource that produces energy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Abiotic factors are the non-living parts of an ecosystem that make up its environment. in terrestrial ecosystems.
 
• Some examples are temperature, light and water. In marine ecosystems, abiotic factors include salinity and ocean currents.
 
• A periodic resources are either not associated with a periodicity or occur with a periodicity.
 
• These often include coal, fuel and gas. A non-renewable resource is a natural resource that cannot be replaced by natural means fast enough to keep up with consumption.
 
• There are four main types of non-renewable resources: oil, natural gas, coal and nuclear power. Oil, natural gas and coal are collectively called fossil fuels.
